_meta.description: The lines this site covers, in hub order. Each line's facts live in src/data/lines/<id>/. project.json and stations.json are required; every other file is optional, and a section without its file does not show. 'alignment' names the GeoJSON file the map and schematic draw from. 'about' feeds the line's schema.org node on every page of that line. 'position_basis' names where station coordinates come from: 'by_source' matches part of a station's location source_url, else 'default'. 'copy' holds the line's own wording for shared pages; {total}, {km} and {name} are filled in. Tokens in copy: {stations}, {as_of}, {pct:<activity>}, {target}, {earlier}, {rest}, {alt}, {minutes} come from project.json. Keys ending in _html may contain inline markup. 'number' is the line's mark; 'colour' names its colour token in src/styles/tokens.css (with an on- token for text on it); a line page whose colour is not line-orange takes it as its accent (data-accent on <html>). 'other_lines' gives a colour to lines the site does not cover, for their mark only; a line in neither list gets a neutral outlined mark. Line 5 and Line 12 share orange, so every mention of a line shows its number with the colour (LineMark.astro). 'dpr_label' names the project report that stations.json dpr_name and dpr_chainage_m come from (default: the 2019 project report, Line 12's).

about.name: Mumbai Metro Line 5
about.description: A metro line from Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, built by MMRDA in three phases. Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, is built and awaiting trial runs.

by_source.livingatlas.arcgis.com/wayback: the built station on satellite imagery, Oct 2025
by_source.x.com/Maha7Arindam: tentative key plan, MMRDA tender, Mar 2026

copy.changes_section: MMRDA's Line 5 page still shows the plan of 2017. The revised plan of 2026 takes the line past Durgadi in a loop to Kalyan, adds a spur to Ulhasnagar and puts Bhiwandi station underground. Here is what changed, figure by figure and station by station.
copy.runs: which will run from Thane through Bhiwandi to Kalyan, with a spur to Ulhasnagar
copy.stations_section: All {total} on the line, in order from Kapurbawdi, then the three on the Line 5A spur and the three the 2017 plan had. Names follow MMRDA. Select a station to ride to it, or open its own page.
copy.stations_page: All {total} on the line, in order from Kapurbawdi in Thane to Kalyan, then the Line 5A spur from Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar. Bhiwandi is underground; every other station is elevated. The line is {km} km long with the spur.
copy.stations_page_description: The stations of {name} in order, from Kapurbawdi in Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar, with interchanges and a page for each station.
copy.route_section: Eighteen stations, Kapurbawdi to Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar. Scroll to ride the line station by station. Distances follow MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025 to the Ulhas river bridge, and the tentative key plan of March 2026 past it.
copy.route_legend: A hollow line marks track that is not yet open, and a dashed outline the underground stretch. No part of Line 5 has opened.
drawn_from: of March 2025 and the tentative key plan of March 2026
copy.headline_html:
Watch Mumbai Metro Line 5 reach Kalyan,
phase by phase.
copy.front_standfirst: Phase 1, from Kapurbawdi in Thane to Dhamankar Naka in Bhiwandi, is built: on {as_of}, MMRDA's progress table showed every civil activity complete. Phases 2 and 3 take the line on to Kalyan, with a spur to Ulhasnagar: {stations} stations in all, as MMRDA counts them.
copy.target_html: Target: {target} for Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, from MMRDA's press release of May 2026. No exact date. The rest of the line: {rest}, as reported.
copy.lead_caption: The Kasheli creek bridge, between Balkum Naka and Kasheli: 550 m long, in spans of 42.23 m, about 15 m above the water, as reported. Illustration, not to scale; not an official design.
copy.map_section: The line on a street map. Choose a station to see where it sits, what surrounds it and what the street looks like today. The route to the Ulhas river bridge comes from MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025; Phase 3 and the spur come from the tentative key plan of March 2026.
copy.map_legend: Route not yet open: MMRDA's alignment file, then the tentative key plan

numbers.length_unit: km with the spur; Bhiwandi underground
numbers.stations_unit: as MMRDA counts them, without Kapurbawdi
numbers.cost_note: Phase 1 ₹6,741 crore, Phase 2 ₹7,326 crore, Phase 5A (Phase 3 and the spur) ₹4,063 crore, MMRDA, May 2026.
numbers.funding_note: In April 2020 AIIB approved a loan concept of USD 236 million for the trains, signalling and power, with the OPEC Fund planned to lend too; MMRDA funds the rest. The final loan amounts are not published.
numbers.travel_unit: than by road (MMRDA, 2026). Its Line 5 page still says 50 to 75%.

about.name: Mumbai Metro Line 4
about.description: An elevated metro line from Wadala through Ghatkopar, Mulund and Thane to Kasarvadavali, with the Line 4A extension to Gaimukh, built by MMRDA. The first stretch, Gaimukh to Cadbury Junction, is built and in trial runs.

copy.stations_page: All {total}, in order from Bhakti Park in Wadala to Kasarvadavali, then Line 4A to Gaimukh. Every station is elevated. Line 4 is {km} km long; Line 4A adds about 2.9 km.

copy.headline_html:
Watch Mumbai Metro Line 4 reach Thane,
stretch by stretch.
copy.front_standfirst: The first stretch, Gaimukh to Cadbury Junction in Thane, is built and in trial runs; it waits for the safety commissioner's approval. The rest of the line to Wadala is still being built: on {as_of}, MMRDA put pier work at about {pct:Pier (viaduct and station, up to platform level)} per cent and the deck slab at about {pct:Deck slab} per cent. {stations} stations on Line 4, as MMRDA counts them, and two more on Line 4A.
copy.target_html: Target: {target} for the first stretch, Gaimukh to Cadbury Junction, as reported: MMRDA aims for “around Diwali or by the end of 2026”. MMRDA has announced no date. Earlier reported targets, December 2025 and April 2026, passed. For the rest of the line to Wadala, the last reported target is October 2027.
